item.title: MASTODON Reveal Plans to Record a Studio Version of BLACK SABBATH’s Legendary Song
item.description: Atlanta progressive metal giants MASTODON have confirmed their intention to record a studio version of the iconic BLACK SABBATH track “Supernaut”. The confirmation came during an interview with Bloodstock TV host Oran O’Beirne at this year’s Bloodstock Open Air festival in the United Kingdom.
